guitar.modelsText: Gibson Flying V / Explorer (Hinds), ESP/Gibson Les Paul (Kelliher)
guitar.notes: Brent Hinds is known for Gibson Flying V and Explorer use; Bill Kelliher has ESP signature models.

tone.target: thick sludge-metal crunch with fuzzy grind and upper-mid bite
tone.profile: thick sludge-metal crunch with fuzzy grind and upper-mid bite
tone.summary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing Fuzz for grit, followed by a powerful Recti amp model into a 4x12 cab, shaped with an OD boost for attack and controlled by a Gate to maintain tightness.
corrections: push gritty fuzz over generic crunch

rig.name: Mastodon - Blood and Thunder - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Tighten the low end and eliminate hum inherent in sludge metal recording.
Provide aggressive riff attack and push the high-gain amp into controlled saturation.
blocks.gap: The 'Tube Screamer focus' suggests a Boost/OD, but Green OD offers a punchier mid-hump suitable for sludge without sounding scooped.

alternatives.reason: A slightly cleaner boost option if the fuzz is too overwhelming.

blocks.purpose: Generate the required fuzzy grind and thick sludge texture.
blocks.gap: None. Fuzz is explicitly requested for grit over generic crunch.

alternatives.reason: If the fuzz needs more aggressive, biting distortion.

blocks.purpose: Provide the necessary high-gain foundation and tight low end characteristic of modern metal.
blocks.gap: None. Recti is ideal for heavy, aggressive tones.

alternatives.reason: A good alternative if the tone needs to be slightly more British/punchy.

blocks.purpose: Simulate a powerful, aggressive 4x12 cabinet suitable for heavy genres.
blocks.gap: While UK Vintage 4x12 is standard, Mess 4x12 often provides a more modern, punchy response needed for sludge metal.

alternatives.reason: A reliable classic choice if the tone needs to be slightly warmer.

blocks.purpose: Sculpt the upper-mids for bite and control excessive low-end rumble while maintaining tightness.
blocks.gap: The goal is 'upper-mid bite' without a scoop. EQ 2 allows precise mid-range shaping to achieve this aggressive focus.

alternatives.reason: A simpler alternative if the tone needs less surgical control.

blocks.purpose: Disabled. Avoids the 'avoid chorus' rule and keeps the tone aggressive.
blocks.gap: None. This block is included to explicitly disable a module that should be avoided, maintaining chain integrity.

blocks.purpose: Disabled. Keeps the focus on raw aggression and avoids unnecessary wash.
blocks.gap: None. Included to ensure all major categories are represented, but kept inactive for maximum punch.

improvements.summary: Upgrade the cabinet simulation for more modern, aggressive sludge metal punch.

proposals.reason: Enhance modern sludge/metal aggression and tightness.
proposals.expectedGain: Punchier low end and upper-mid bite
